He’s Just Not That Into You
Men and women try to navigate through the complexities of modern relationships.
A European (Tom Hanks) living in an airport befriends a stewardess (Catherine Zeta-Jones).
Family tradition keeps a young Mexican (Lumi Cavazos) from her true love (Marco Leonardi).
Rocker (David Arquette) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) want out of small town.
An elite hit-man (Jason Statham) teaches his deadly trade to an apprentice (Ben Foster).
Jailed for her husband's murder, a woman (Ashley Judd) learns he (Bruce Greenwood) lives.
Two men find themselves in an ongoing feud after a car accident.
Aliens kidnap actors from an old sci-fi TV series to fight a war.
Kids' wedding, romantic prospect preoccupy retirees (Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau).
A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate an abduction.
A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a deadly plot.
A freak accident lets an ad exec (Mel Gibson) read women's minds.
Count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy.
A cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) bonds with a female boxer (Hilary Swank).
